source.title: Toward Better Assessment of LLMs’ Performance in Clinical Error Detection
source.source_type: preprint accepted at MLHC 2026; to appear in PMLR Vol. 340

extraction_limitations: Appendix G Tables 11–14 contain all 240 per-run traditional-metric rows; the atom set captures the paper’s independently emphasized aggregate and comparative assertions rather than atomizing every repeated table cell.
Table 15 detailed ECA values are represented through the source’s reported dataset-level and category-level summaries plus robustness findings rather than one atom per model-cell.
The schema has no ML-benchmark-specific structured context; model/dataset/configuration details are represented with generic population, exposure, outcome, tags, and source anchors.
Atoms are machine-extracted and marked needs_review; no human verification status was asserted.
